snow_floor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one SEAMLESS TILEABLE game terrain ALBEDO TEXTURE, a square image, designed on a 256x256 HARD-EDGE PIXEL ART grid. Paint the material itself edge-to-edge; NO image border, no margin, no tile outline, no perspective slab, no transparency. This is a flat material map, not a lit scene.
CRITICAL: EXACT FOUR-WAY SEAMLESS tiling, left edge continues perfectly into right edge, top edge continues perfectly into bottom edge. Treat canvas as a torus: any shape hitting an edge must wrap to the opposite edge with matching color and continuity. Even distribution throughout, no central focal point, no distinctive symbol, no vignette, no outer stripe. Repeating 3x3 must look like one continuous material field with no grid.
UNLIT INTRINSIC MATERIAL COLOR ONLY: NO directional illumination, NO cast shadows, NO shiny highlights, NO specular, NO ambient occlusion shading around stones, NO raised 3D edges. Only narrow dark natural cracks/crevices are allowed. No gradients or blurred transitions, no soft brush, no antialiasing. Use crisp irregular PIXEL CLUSTERS, large and medium and small clusters nested naturally, not a regular checkerboard or artificial repeated noise pattern. Hand-painted art direction rather than algorithmic noise. Do not draw objects, plants, footprints or writing unless specified. MATERIAL snow_floor: Flat top-down PACKED SNOW walkable ground, cool blue-white compacted snow field with sparse exposed dark gray frozen earth and tiny stone chips. Overall fairly bright cool blue, but DARKER and more compressed than fresh thick plateau snow: favor c5d0ea/ccd6ed and b8c6e2, with a few pale snow flecks. Exposed frozen earth around 10-15% area in dispersed small irregular patches. No tracks, boot prints, road lines, directional light, or large recognizable marks. Broad even coverage and low-frequency mineral/snow patches plus small hard pixel edge detail.
SCALE: this tile covers 5x5 meters; human height is 1.6m. Respect the described feature scale.
PALETTE: use ONLY these 9 sRGB hexadecimal colors (and ensure all 9 appear as natural material-color variation, not swatches): #9199af, #b8c6e2, #c5d0ea, #ccd6ed, #dae2f3, #eef2fa, #4c4d57, #6b6d78, #8a8c96. Solid color clusters only, NO dithering gradients. Return one continuous square seamless texture, not a 3x3 preview and not a swatch sheet.
